No shift was opened during testing. Note: /api/sales?date_from&date_to is the paginated sales endpoint (not /sales/paginated).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: same sale appeared on '20 sept.' in weekly chart but '21 sept.' in payment-mode widget due to different date grouping (UTC func.date vs local timezone). Fix: services/tz_service.py centralises pharmacy-timezone bounds; all reports endpoints (/dashboard, /today-sales-by-payment, /weekly, /sales, /sales-summary) plus repositories_extended.py sales paginated filter now use local_day_bounds() → both graph and widget group by same local day. Frontend Date.prototype patch + dateService.formatDateTz ensure UI matches. Verified: sale VNT-E69E6A47 (56168 GNF, created_at 21/09/2026 14:04 UTC) appears on 21 sept. in both graph and widget.
